title: Living Legacy: Battle Prowess
summary: Defeat the Avatar quickly while matching each defense and destroying despair adds.
overview: Defeat the Avatar quickly while matching each defense and destroying despair adds.

phases.label: Open defenses
phases.description: Every spell and weapon is effective.

phases.label: Changing defenses
phases.description: In order: cold and hand-to-hand; magic and piercing; poison and slashing; disease and blunt; fire and two-handed weapons.

phases.label: Final assault
phases.description: All attack types become effective again.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Match the announced spell school or weapon style as the Avatar changes defenses.
Stand inside a green rune for two seconds to gain twenty seconds of attunement when your usual attacks are unsuitable.
Destroy each trio of despair manifestations within 45 seconds.
The final quarter of the Avatar's health opens every attack type again.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 7.
